fields.statement: Verified fea2a6b29 at HEAD under the capped scope: go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 ./internal/api -run Inbox ok (includes TestInboxIndexedReadsNoLog: zero log reads with IndexPath set, overlaps/titles/gate questions equal to the log fold, a gate run whose worktree is gone keeps its item with the question handle, no statement, no error); go test ./internal/api -run 'TestPropertyProjectionParity|Proposal|Uncovered|Overlap|Daemon' ok; go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/inbox ok over all 20 inbox*.txtar (RHIZA_/SHIP_/REX_ unset); go vet ./internal/api exit 0; grep -n 'index.Open\|openWriteIndex' internal/api/inbox.go prints nothing (exit 1). Diff read: inboxFold uses ws.useProjection/changeSetInfos/entries/model, overlaps name targets via overlapItems over the projection's as-is model (same handle/statement as before); inboxUncoveredProposals (callers inbox.go:841 and :1236 only) uses only len(leaves), so the nil rank changes no item or --json; inboxGateRead already uses openProjection and is unchanged; internal/run untouched; no TODOs.
